standard: Method card: identifying scrubber gain, efficiency and response time
purpose: Identify scrubber dynamic response (gain, time constant, delay) from room CO2 concentration response to commanded speed steps
hypotheses: First-order dynamic response with gain, time constant, and delay
Cabin CO2 concentration reflects scrubber removal dynamics coupled with room exchange and mixing
Transport delay and response time constant are distinguishable from observations

expected.description: CO2 concentration in lab responds to speed steps with first-order exponential decay/rise, allowing estimation of gain (steady-state CO2 change per speed step), time constant (response lag), and delay (transport delay). If data cannot distinguish scrubber dynamics from exchange/mixing/sensor effects, report effective behaviour bounds.
